An architectural recreation of the Westminster riverfront, built with Three.js. Streets, riverbanks, building outlines and tree locations: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, via Geofabrik. Building heights use mapped values where available and estimates elsewhere. The wider skyline uses simplified mapped volumes and roof forms. Regional map source (ODbL, gzip). Façade textures are AI-generated architectural interpretations. Clock Tower by ManySince910, CC BY 4.0, resized and optimized, via Objaverse. Abbey west-front photograph: Oleg Yunakov, CC BY-SA 4.0, resized to WebP and perspective mapped. Abbey geometry is an architectural interpretation. County Hall riverfront photograph: Doyle of London, CC BY-SA 4.0, resized to WebP and perspective mapped; adapted texture under the same license. County Hall roof, columns and cupola are architectural interpretations. Environment, stone and tree: Poly Haven (CC0). Water normals: Three.js (MIT).
